name: contract
title: Contract library
owns: The shared implementation of this specification's common rules: typed identifiers, timestamps and digests, canonical JSON, the schema validator, the request and response envelopes and the command-line harness, exit states, atomic record files, the home event journal and transaction locks, the validated reader of the shared reads, and the one process-execution path. It owns no command, no store and no record of its own.
test_scope: Every schema against valid and invalid fixtures, the schema profile, identifier and canonical-form vectors, envelope and exit-state mapping, size errors, atomic replacement and journal recovery, and the agreement of the package declarations with this specification, including the acyclic call graph and that the shared reads add no call and no lock.
